solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Police arrest leading lad shooting darts

indicators.note: the police detectives take the other piece into custody, holding it inside them

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the detective branch of British police
being up means being ahead, as in a game

explanation.surface: Detectives arrest a youth who was at the front of a group firing darts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading lad' reads as one phrase, but 'leading' belongs to the wordplay and 'lad shooting darts' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman god of love is pictured as a boy firing arrows, which the clue calls darts.

clue.text: Advice to buyer: try timeless ring owned by speleologist

indicators.note: the cave explorer holds the other pieces, which sit inside his letters

parts.note: a speleologist explores caves, so is a caver

indicators.note: less a time, so one T (the abbreviation for time) goes from the word for try

parts.note: to try is to attempt
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: Odd shopping advice: attempt a ring that a cave explorer once owned.
explanation.walkthrough: The Latin phrase means 'let the buyer beware'.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin maxim is the classic warning to purchasers that the risk of a bad bargain is theirs.

clue.text: Slate lawyer, bamboo fancier

parts.note: to pan a play or book is to criticise it harshly, to slate it
DA is a District Attorney, an American prosecutor

explanation.surface: A lawyer who loves bamboo gets criticised.
explanation.definitionFit: The giant panda of China lives almost entirely on bamboo, so it is a keen eater of the plant.

clue.text: Stooping to secure second creative work

indicators.note: the stooping word holds the other piece fast inside it

parts.note: deigning is condescending, lowering oneself to do something

explanation.surface: Someone lowers themselves to land a second piece of creative work.
explanation.definitionFit: Designing is the creative activity of planning how something will look and work.

clue.text: Club next to apartment that's used to press

indicators.note: the club follows the apartment, sitting beside it

parts.note: a flat is an apartment
an iron is a type of golf club

explanation.surface: A golf club next door to a flat used for pressing something.
explanation.definitionFit: A flatiron is an old-fashioned smoothing iron, heated on a stove and used to press clothes.

clue.text: One piece of writing in career is unconvincing

indicators.note: the number and the manuscript go inside the word for career

parts.note: to career is to rush along, to fly
I is the Roman numeral one
MS is a manuscript

explanation.surface: One article in someone's working life fails to persuade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Career' looks like a noun about a job but is the verb meaning to hurtle.
explanation.definitionFit: A flimsy excuse or argument is weak and easily seen through, so it fails to convince.

clue.text: Arabian film star engages university in dispute

parts.note: Ar. is a dictionary abbreviation for Arabic or Arabian

indicators.note: the film star takes on the university, holding it inside his name

parts.note: Clark Gable was a Hollywood star of Gone with the Wind

explanation.surface: An Arab actor takes on a university in a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Something arguable is open to debate, so its truth is still contested.

clue.text: Whitish yellow plant that climbs walls

indicators.note: the climbing plant surrounds the colour, like a wall around it

parts.note: ivy is a climbing plant
or is gold or yellow in heraldry

explanation.surface: A pale yellow climber growing up the walls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whitish yellow' reads as one colour, and the answer is such a colour, but only 'Whitish' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivory is the creamy off-white colour of elephant tusks.

clue.text: Victor replaced by Number 10 in patent offensive

indicators.note: one letter of the patent word is swapped out for another piece

parts.note: patent means plain to see, obvious
Victor is V in the NATO phonetic alphabet
NO is number and X is the Roman numeral ten

explanation.surface: A political tale: the winner ousted by Downing Street in a plainly offensive move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number 10' suggests the Prime Minister's house in Downing Street, but it is just NO and the Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Obnoxious means extremely unpleasant, objectionable.

clue.text: Raphael's first avoids glazing detail, creating illusion

indicators.note: the glazing word goes without the letter, leaving it out

parts.note: varnishing gives a painting a glossy glaze

indicators.note: only the initial letter of the painter's name is used

parts.note: the painter's name supplies just its opening letter
a point is an item or detail

explanation.surface: Raphael's painting skips the glazing but its detail fools the eye.
explanation.walkthrough: The painting surface is apt: Renaissance painters such as Raphael used linear perspective.
explanation.definitionFit: In perspective drawing, parallel lines meet at this spot, giving a flat picture the illusion of depth.

clue.text: Like buccaneer briefly left below island hoping to make it

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece below another comes after it

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter of the buccaneer goes

parts.note: a buccaneer is a pirate
Iona is an island in the Scottish Hebrides

explanation.surface: A pirate, left on an island, longs to get rich.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspirational describes someone ambitious, wanting to succeed and rise in the world.

clue.text: Insensitive state drivers commandeering a single convertible

indicators.note: the drivers' body seizes the other letters, holding them inside

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motoring organisation

indicators.note: convertible means able to be changed, so these letters change their order

parts.note: these two words provide the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A motorists' group seizes one convertible car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Convertible' looks like a car but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Analgesia is the medical term for an inability to feel pain.

clue.text: Yankee cabs ignoring sort of junction feature in chart

parts.note: Yankee is Y in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: the cabs word leaves out the letter, passing it over

parts.note: taxis are cabs
a T-junction is where one road meets another at right angles

explanation.surface: American cabs skipping a road junction shown on a map.
explanation.definitionFit: On a graph, the vertical line of reference is called this, plotted against the horizontal one.

clue.text: Guard for pupil that's batted sometimes

definitions.meaning: pupil reads as a schoolchild but is the dark centre of the eye
suggests cricket, but here it means blinked or fluttered

explanation.surface: A cricket scene: someone protecting a schoolboy who sometimes bats.
explanation.walkthrough: To bat an eyelid is to blink, as in 'didn't bat an eyelid'.
explanation.definitionFit: This fold of skin covers and protects the eye, and is what you bat when you flutter or blink.

clue.text: Stocky type to finish concert up in old hotel

parts.note: to end is to finish

indicators.note: the reversed concert goes inside the old and hotel letters

parts.note: Hotel is H in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up reads the concert word from bottom to top

parts.note: a prom is a promenade concert, such as the BBC Proms

explanation.surface: A burly sort ends a concert in an old hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: An endomorph has a heavy, rounded build in the old classification of body types.

clue.text: Grand boy, taking violin out of case, blossoms

parts.note: G is slang for a grand, a thousand pounds or dollars
a lad is a boy

indicators.note: the violin comes out of its case, losing its outer letters

parts.note: the instrument's name with its outer letters removed

explanation.surface: A fine boy, taking his violin from its case, brings flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: These are tall plants of the iris family with spikes of showy flowers.

clue.text: Minister's aide tormented a co-ed head

indicators.note: the letters are twisted about, as if in torment

parts.note: these words provide the letters to be rearranged
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness

explanation.surface: A student was tormented by her head teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: A co-ed is a female student at a mixed college.
explanation.definitionFit: A deaconess is a woman who assists a church minister in pastoral duties.

clue.text: Put differently, traveller has English about right

parts.note: a rep is a travelling sales representative

indicators.note: the has and English letters wrap around the right letter

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A salesman has an English accent, roughly correct.
explanation.definitionFit: To rephrase is to express the same idea again in other words.

clue.text: Go round twisty ridge, making descent

indicators.note: the go word goes around the scrambled letters

parts.note: to go is a colloquial way of saying to urinate, to pee

indicators.note: twisted, so the letters of the ridge are rearranged

parts.note: the word itself provides the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A hiker goes around a winding ridge and starts downhill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Descent' suggests going downhill, but it means ancestry.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedigree is a line of ancestry, the family line from which one is descended.

clue.text: A source of unwellness in northern ocean?

definitions.text: A source of unwellness in northern ocean?

indicators.note: the A and the first letter sit inside the northern ocean letters

parts.note: the sea is the ocean
taken as written

indicators.note: the source is the start, so only the first letter of unwellness is used

parts.note: the word supplies just its opening letter

explanation.surface: Wondering whether the North Sea is what makes sailors feel ill.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: seasickness on a northern ocean is a cause of feeling ill.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea is the queasy feeling of sickness, of which rough seas are a classic cause.

clue.text: Holy city with current version of Chinese script

parts.note: pi is schoolboy slang for pious
NY is New York
in means fashionable, current

explanation.surface: A holy city has an up-to-date writing system for Chinese.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinyin is the standard system for spelling Mandarin in the Roman alphabet.

clue.text: Old queen in charge of resistance unit

definitions.note: a phrase meaning relating to the unit, matching an adjective

parts.note: HM is Her Majesty
IC means in charge, as in 2IC

explanation.surface: An elderly queen commanding a band of resistance fighters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resistance unit' suggests a cell of partisans, but it is electrical.
explanation.definitionFit: Ohmic means relating to the ohm, the SI unit of electrical resistance.

clue.text: Cold fish behave like limpets

parts.note: a ling is a long fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Chilly fish act like shellfish stuck to a rock.
explanation.definitionFit: Limpets are molluscs famous for fastening tightly to rocks, so to stick fast is to act like them.

clue.text: Home Office head stops just over a hundred masses

parts.note: the Home Office is the UK government department for policing and immigration

indicators.note: the head plugs the number, sitting inside it like a stopper

parts.note: 101 written in digits looks like these letters
the poll is an old word for the head, as in poll tax

explanation.surface: A government department's chief halts just over a hundred people.
explanation.walkthrough: The digits of 101 are read as letters, I, O and I.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek phrase means 'the many', used for the common people, the masses.

clue.text: Dance round under branch

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece under another comes after it

parts.note: a limb is a large branch of a tree
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Dancing in a circle beneath a tree branch.
explanation.definitionFit: The limbo is a West Indian dance in which you bend back to pass under a lowered bar.

clue.text: Is it always plain sailing for him?

definitions.meaning: sailing points to a sailor, a man of the sea

explanation.walkthrough: Plain sailing means easy going; here 'plain' becomes the first word of a navy rank and 'sailing' the sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the lowest rank of sailor in the Royal Navy, an unremarkable seafarer.

clue.text: Diver with navy enlists Europeans supplying sharkskin

parts.note: a shag is a seabird that dives for fish, related to the cormorant

indicators.note: the navy takes the Europeans into its ranks, holding them inside

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy
E is European, doubled for the plural

explanation.surface: A diver joins the navy, which recruits Europeans who supply shark hides.
explanation.definitionFit: Shagreen is untanned rough leather, often made from the skin of a shark or ray.

clue.text: Lower front of sister's hood

indicators.note: the front is the start, so only the first letter is used

parts.note: the word supplies just its opening letter
a cowl is a monk's hood

explanation.surface: Pull down the front of your sister's hood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lower' looks like the verb to bring down, but it is the verb that rhymes with 'flower', to frown.
explanation.definitionFit: To lower, also spelt lour, is to frown or look sullen and threatening.
